description.value: Supio is a legal AI company that sells software to plaintiff and personal injury law firms.
Supio is a Seattle-based legal AI company that builds software for personal injury and mass tort firms.
Supio is an AI software company focused on personal injury and mass tort firms.

product_description.value: Supio is the only agentic legal AI platform built for plaintiff law and mass torts cases, with Supio Agent running at both case level and firm level.

Supio Agent (chronologies, demand letters, case economics, litigation drafting, firm intelligence), Supio Intake and Case Communications, with Westlaw, case management and document system integrations and an API.
Supio Document Intelligence platform for personal injury documents, Supio Assistant chat tool and Case Economics billing tool; also demand letter automation and drafting of complaints and briefs.

customer_description.value: Plaintiff and personal injury law firms; the homepage shows logos for about 27 firms, including GLP, Hughes and Coleman, Phillips Law Group, TorHoerman Law and Welsh & Welsh.
Plaintiff law firms and mass torts practices; logos include Ankin Law, The Cochran Firm, Rainwater Holt and Oatley Vigmond, among about two dozen others.
Personal injury and mass tort firms; reported customers include Hughes & Coleman and Thomas Law Offices.

employees.value: Estimates range from roughly 11-50 (Promptloop) to 163 (StartupHub); about 100 (TechCrunch-sourced), 120 (Bitscale), 134 (Built In).
110 (one aggregator); 100-person staff with plans to double (TechCrunch-based coverage).
